name: plate_holder
notes: 96-well SBS plate holder (127.76 x 85.48 mm footprint) with 4 alignment pins. Walls at 60% plate height, 2 mm thick; 0.5 mm clearance on the inner pocket.

name: tip_rack_holder
notes: Pipette tip rack holder tray (122 x 80 mm SBS variant footprint). 10 mm walls, 3 mm base, 0.5 mm clearance. Pipette-agnostic deck geometry shared across SO-101, XZ-gantry, and i3 Mega contexts.

name: deck_plate_assembly
notes: i3 Mega deck plate, combined assembly (229.8 x 219.8 mm, 6 mm tall). Holds tip box, 96-well plate, reservoir, and used-tips bin via 2 mm lip fences over a 4 mm base. Full-footprint cutouts under each labware (parts drop through to the bed). 8 perimeter clamp pockets where i3 bed clips engage (2 mm top face at each pocket). Origin (0,0,0) at the 96-well plate slot's left-front corner with Y mirror for top-down CAD viewers.

name: tip_ejection_bar
notes: Fixed post for top-button ejector activation.

name: dpette_single_cradle
notes: Rest cradle for AELAB dPette 7016 single-channel.

name: dpette_tip_release
notes: L-bracket tip ejector station with waste slot.

name: i3_carriage_dpette_mount_main
notes: Horizontal-bolt mount (scheme a) — main piece. 4× M4 in 21×13 mm pattern on the i3 Mega horizontal head-mount plate. Back half of the split upper clamp (D-cavity, opens to −Y) + vertical post + lower horseshoe clamp around the 78×11 fixed-tip manifold.

name: i3_carriage_dpette_mount_cap
notes: Front cap for the split upper clamp. Bolts to the main piece via 2× M3 to capture the dPette+ Ø27 round upper barrel. Required because the dPette+ body is one rigid unit (lower body / upper barrel / top section permanently joined) — lateral insertion is impossible.

name: i3_carriage_dpette_mount_main_lbracket
notes: Scheme b — main piece + L-bracket reinforcement. Adds a web rising from the back of the top plate to a flange at z = 27.5 mm with 2× M4 clearance holes (28 mm pitch) that thread down into the carriage vertical-plate top. Resists pitch torque under XY acceleration. Pairs with the same cap as scheme a.
